decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the replacement community facility would not result in harm to the amenities of neighbouring uses, would not harm the appearance of the street scene and would not result in a decline in highway safety. The proposal would continue to provide a community facility for which there is an identified need in the Borough and is therefore acceptable in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), C.1.4 (New social and community facilities) and T.1.4 (Car & cycle parking & servicing facilities for developments).
description: Erection of a detached single storey building for Community Use.
